basic_information.official_title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A LEVEL 1 GENERAL HOSPITAL WITH TWENTY-FIVE BED CAPACITY IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF SOUTH UBIAN, PROVINCE OF TAWI-TAWI TO BE KNOWN AS THE SOUTH UBIAN GENERAL HOSPITAL AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
signed_by: Prof. Raby B. Angkal, Secretary General
basic_information.effectivity: 15 days after publication in a newspaper of regional circulation

citizen_summary.what_is_this_about: Creates a 25-bed Level 1 general hospital in South Ubian, Tawi-Tawi, to serve the municipality and its neighbouring islands — with ₱50 million named and a funding source identified.
citizen_summary.why_was_it_proposed: To put comprehensive and integrated health services within reach of an island municipality where the nearest hospital means a sea crossing.
citizen_summary.what_will_change: A Level 1 general hospital is established under the direct supervision of the Ministry of Health, which determines its structure and plantilla positions and integrates the Universal Health Care Act into its operations.
who_will_be_affected: People on the neighbouring islands the act expressly names
Health workers appointed to the new plantilla positions
citizen_summary.when_will_it_take_effect: In force since 2025 — 15 days after publication.

what_this_means_for_you.in_short: NOW LAW. A 25-bed Level 1 hospital for South Ubian and its neighbouring islands, with ₱50 million named in the act itself.

for_specific_groups.Island residents: Section 2 expressly covers the neighbouring islands, not just the municipality — the catchment is written to match how people actually reach care here.
for_specific_groups.Health workers: The Ministry of Health determines and approves plantilla positions, so the posts are created rather than assumed.
for_specific_groups.PhilHealth members: The hospital must integrate the Universal Health Care Act.

key_terms_explained.Level 1 hospital: A basic facility — emergency care, general medicine, a small ward.
key_terms_explained.Plantilla position: A permanent, funded post in the government staffing structure.
key_terms_explained.MPBF: Miscellaneous Personnel Benefits Fund — the budget line the initial ₱50 million is charged against.
key_terms_explained.UHC Act: Republic Act 11223, the national Universal Health Care law.

everyday_scenarios: A patient on an island near South Ubian previously faced a sea crossing for basic hospital care. Section 2 writes the neighbouring islands into the hospital's purpose.
A nurse asks whether permanent posts exist. The Ministry of Health determines and approves the plantilla positions under Section 4.

key_provisions: Section 1 — Establishes the South Ubian General Hospital in the Municipality of South Ubian, Province of Tawi-Tawi, to address the health and social services of its constituents.

Section 2 — Purpose: a Level 1 general hospital of 25-bed capacity providing comprehensive and integrated health services to the people of South Ubian and its neighbouring islands, as an essential institution in the effective delivery of the health system.
Section 3 — The hospital shall include the units and services the Ministry of Health deems necessary, integrating the appropriate provisions of Republic Act 11223, the Universal Health Care Act.
Section 4 — The hospital is under the direct supervision of the Ministry of Health, which determines and approves its organisational structure and plantilla positions.

Section 5 — An initial ₱50,000,000 is charged against the Miscellaneous Personnel Benefits Fund of the 2025 General Appropriation Act of the Bangsamoro. Thereafter funds for operations are included in the annual appropriations.
Section 6 — Takes effect 15 days after publication in a newspaper of regional circulation.

citizen_questions.q: What kind of hospital is it?
citizen_questions.a: A Level 1 general hospital with 25 beds — basic emergency care, general medicine and a small ward. Specialist cases are still referred onward.

citizen_questions.q: Does it serve only South Ubian?
citizen_questions.a: No. Section 2 names the people of South Ubian and its neighbouring islands.

citizen_questions.q: How much money, and from where?
citizen_questions.a: An initial ₱50 million charged against the Miscellaneous Personnel Benefits Fund of the 2025 Bangsamoro budget. Later operations run through the annual appropriations.
